gloss: in a horizontal line; in a row side by side

definitions.gloss: horizontal line; single row; side by side in a line
definitions.explanation: A formation where people or things are arranged in one line from left to right (as opposed to a vertical column). Used for physical arrangements and figuratively for equal status.

examples.japanese: {横|よこ}{一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: To line up in a horizontal row.

examples.japanese: ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{横|よこ}{一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: I arranged the chairs in a single row.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{横|よこ}{一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つないで⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The children are walking in a line, holding hands side by side.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal, side) and ⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧ (single row/line). Describes a formation where people or objects are arranged in a single horizontal line, side by side.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横|よこ}{一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in a horizontal row
- {横|よこ}{一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to arrange in a horizontal row
- {横|よこ}{一列|いちれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to form a horizontal line

USAGE:
Sometimes used to describe a situation where everyone is on equal footing with no one ahead or behind: {横|よこ}{一列|いちれつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧ (everyone starting on equal terms).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧: in a vertical column / single file — arranged front to back
- ⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧: single line — without specifying horizontal or vertical orientation
- ⟦{横並|よこなら}び→横並び：20264_yokonarabi⟧: side by side; keeping pace with others — often figurative
